★ HYBRID A+B — the final direction
A's verdict-first top (plain verdict + hero %, one "profile vs. price" bar with the +17 edge callout, tier strip) with B's trends shown INLINE instead of behind a tap. Comps stay one tap away. Built to be responsive: this compact stack on a phone; on a wide draft board the trends widen and comps can sit beside them.
A · VERDICT-FIRST — the compact parent. Everything below the tier strip (comps + trends) collapses behind tap rows.
B · SCANNABLE — the dense parent. The inline trends table in the hybrid comes from here.
C · GUIDED CARDS — kept for reference. Friendliest / most mobile, but the most taps to reach detail.
CURRENT — what ships today, for contrast: six competing numbers, the jargon "Two groups" heading, no plain-language verdict.
